playlists.title: Choro Getting Started Crash Course
playlists.description: Beginner playlist · about 26 min. Follow one project from setup to parallel agents, context, design, review, shipping, Orbit, Solo, and mobile.

videos.title: Meet Choro and the Core Workflow
videos.flow: Projects → multiple agents → project home → center workspace
videos.viewer_value: Builds the mental model for managing several projects and agents from one place.

videos.title: Projects Are More Than Repositories
videos.flow: Add Project → choose folder → explore its dedicated workspace
videos.viewer_value: Shows a project as a durable home for its work and context, not just a repository shortcut.

videos.title: Complete Your First Agent Flow
videos.flow: New Agent → simple request → result → Changed Files → What to Check
videos.viewer_value: Teaches the pure agent loop before adding advanced tools or setup.

videos.title: Work from Context: Tasks and Docs
videos.flow: Task or Doc → Implement → linked agent → Changed Files → Verification
videos.viewer_value: Keeps the original brief attached from implementation through a verified result.

videos.title: Plan the Work Before Building
videos.flow: Plan mode → questions → persistent plan → Implement → result
videos.viewer_value: Shows how uncertain work becomes a clear plan that stays visible while the agent builds.

videos.title: Go from Task to Design to Preview
videos.flow: Task → Design → Implement → Preview feedback
videos.viewer_value: Connects the brief, visual direction, implementation, and live refinement in one fast story.

videos.title: Run Scripts and Fix Backend Work
videos.flow: Saved script → backend request by dictation → Code Review → Fix All
videos.viewer_value: Combines repeatable commands, hands-free prompting, and review into a practical backend loop.

videos.title: Explore Code, Files, Terminal, and Database
videos.flow: Code → Files → editor → Terminal → Database
videos.viewer_value: Maps the technical workspace for the moments when users want direct control.

videos.title: Ask and Add Context Without an Agent
videos.flow: Customize project → add Assets → Quick Ask → tag a reference
videos.viewer_value: Uses project context for quick answers, then reuses the same context in agent work.

videos.title: Explore Orbit's Project Intelligence
videos.flow: Environment → integrations → custom Analytics view
videos.viewer_value: Shows built-in project knowledge and a custom structured view without a deep setup lesson.

videos.title: Ship the Completed Work
videos.flow: Agent result → Git overview → Ship → branch, push, and PR
videos.viewer_value: Turns finished work into a traceable branch and pull request through one guided flow.

videos.title: Try Parallel Work with Solo
videos.flow: Start Solo → separate lane → switch work → bring home
videos.viewer_value: Shows how to run isolated work in parallel without mixing branches.

videos.title: Take Choro with You on Mobile
videos.flow: Mac runs Choro → iPhone follows → respond remotely
videos.viewer_value: Ends with the simple mobile promise: the Mac does the work while the phone keeps you connected.

playlists.title: Agents
playlists.description: Start the right kind of work, follow it clearly, and coordinate parallel tasks.

videos.title: Set Up an Agent for the Task
videos.flow: Choose model → effort → access → Build or Plan
videos.viewer_value: Helps users make the important setup decisions together.

videos.title: Plan Before You Build
videos.flow: Plan mode → review proposal → refine → implement
videos.viewer_value: Reduces wrong turns on larger or uncertain work.

videos.title: Follow and Manage Your Agents
videos.flow: Board → status → questions or approvals → completion
videos.viewer_value: Makes several active conversations easy to supervise.

videos.title: Agent Cards: What They Mean and What to Check
videos.flow: Progress → decisions → outputs → verification → delivery
videos.viewer_value: Shows which cards need attention, what evidence to inspect, and the next safe action.

videos.title: Work in Parallel with Solo
videos.flow: Start Solo → independent lane → review → bring home
videos.viewer_value: Lets users run parallel work without mixing branches.

videos.title: Continue a Saved Conversation
videos.flow: Open completed agent → Resume → continue with context
videos.viewer_value: Keeps previous decisions and work available when a task returns.

playlists.title: Band & Delegation
playlists.description: Give one lead a team of specialists. Set up bandmates, delegate by name, and follow their work through one verified result.

videos.title: Build a Feature with Your Band
videos.flow: Name two bandmates → lead assigns work → follow both chats → verified result
videos.viewer_value: Combines different specialists in one task while the lead coordinates and checks the result.

videos.title: Set Up a Bandmate
videos.flow: Settings → Band → Edit or New → model and instructions → save
videos.viewer_value: Saves a reusable specialist setup without repeating the same brief in every chat.

videos.title: Give a Bandmate the Right Skills
videos.flow: Skills → inspect guidance → add or write a skill → apply → save
videos.viewer_value: Combines focused guidance with reusable skills and Riffs in one specialist.

videos.title: Start a Chat with a Bandmate
videos.flow: New Agent → / → Bandmates → task → send
videos.viewer_value: Uses a specialist directly when the task does not need a coordinating lead.

videos.title: Bring a Bandmate into Work Already Started
videos.flow: Existing chat → /delegate → choose bandmate → brief → assignment
videos.viewer_value: Adds specialist help midway through a task without manually copying the conversation.

videos.title: Follow Your Band and Give Feedback
videos.flow: Band panel → assignment chat → correction → summary → lead result
videos.viewer_value: Keeps every assignment accessible while the lead remains the main conversation.

videos.title: Stop Your Band and Resume When Ready
videos.flow: Stop → lead-only conversation → restart → explicit Resume
videos.viewer_value: Lets users pause delegated work without losing chats, drafts, or working files.

playlists.title: Tasks & Docs
playlists.description: Capture the brief once, then hand the complete context to an agent.

videos.title: Create a Doc for a New Feature
videos.flow: Docs → write brief → organize decisions
videos.viewer_value: Creates one durable source of truth before implementation.

videos.title: Turn a Doc into Agent Work
videos.flow: Open Doc → Implement → review context → send
videos.viewer_value: Avoids rewriting the feature brief in chat.

videos.title: Turn a Task into Agent Work
videos.flow: Open task → Implement → linked agent → result
videos.viewer_value: Keeps the ticket, requirements, and agent work attached.

videos.title: Connect an External Task Board
videos.flow: Add source → connect board → filter tasks → implement
videos.viewer_value: Brings existing team work into the same Choro flow.

playlists.title: Review & Ship
playlists.description: Understand what changed, catch issues, and turn finished work into a pull request.

videos.title: Review What the Agent Changed
videos.flow: Agent result → changed files → diff → verification
videos.viewer_value: Shows whether the result matches the request before shipping.

videos.title: Run Code Review
videos.flow: Review → findings → checklist → ask for fixes
videos.viewer_value: Adds a focused quality gate without leaving the conversation.

videos.title: Ship Completed Work
videos.flow: Ship → choose changes → generate details → commit, push, PR
videos.viewer_value: Turns reviewed work into a clean pull request in one guided flow.

videos.title: Track PRs and Workflows
videos.flow: Git → PRs → checks → merge status
videos.viewer_value: Keeps delivery status visible beside the work that created it.

playlists.title: Run & Preview
playlists.description: Run the project, inspect output, and send precise visual feedback.

videos.title: Run Saved Project Scripts
videos.flow: Choose script → run → inspect terminal → stop or rerun
videos.viewer_value: Makes repeated build, test, and server commands one click away.

videos.title: Open Your Running Project in Preview
videos.flow: Run service → detected URL → Preview → navigate
videos.viewer_value: Keeps the live product beside the code and agent conversation.

videos.title: Give Visual Feedback in Preview
videos.flow: Review mode → select element or area → comment → agent
videos.viewer_value: Sends exact visual evidence instead of a vague description.

videos.title: Inspect Code, Files, and Terminal Together
videos.flow: Code → Files → editor → terminal
videos.viewer_value: Keeps everyday project inspection inside one workspace.

playlists.title: Design
playlists.description: Move from requirements to a design, implementation, and live comparison.

videos.title: Create a Design from a Doc or Task
videos.flow: Open brief → Design → choose model → generate
videos.viewer_value: Turns written requirements into a visual direction without re-briefing.

videos.title: Refine a Design with the Assistant
videos.flow: Open design → request changes → inspect canvas → iterate
videos.viewer_value: Keeps design decisions and revisions in one focused conversation.

videos.title: Implement a Design with an Agent
videos.flow: Select design → Implement → agent builds → Preview
videos.viewer_value: Gives the coding agent the exact visual source of truth.

videos.title: Compare the Design with the Live Result
videos.flow: Open design → Compare → inspect result → refine
videos.viewer_value: Makes visual gaps easy to see before the feature is finished.

videos.title: Use Visual References with an Agent
videos.flow: Add image, file, or link → add notes → Use in Agent
videos.viewer_value: Keeps inspiration, brand files, and implementation context together.

playlists.title: Orbit
playlists.description: See project environment and integrations, then create structured views that connect to agent work.

videos.title: Meet Orbit
videos.flow: Open Orbit → built-ins → custom modules → project view
videos.viewer_value: Explains when structured modules are more useful than a Doc or Task.

videos.title: Manage Environment Variables in Orbit
videos.flow: Environment → choose env file → search or filter → edit and save
videos.viewer_value: Finds and updates project variables across app areas without hunting through files.

videos.title: See Project Services and Integrations
videos.flow: Integrations → choose project area → inspect detected services → open dashboard
videos.viewer_value: Creates a useful inventory of services detected from project dependencies and configuration.

videos.title: Create a Reusable Orbit Module
videos.flow: Analytics or blank → fields → grouped view → agent job
videos.viewer_value: Lets users shape repeatable project tools around their own workflow.

videos.title: Use an Orbit Module in a Project
videos.flow: Add module → create records → organize view → run agent job
videos.viewer_value: Turns structured project data into an actionable workflow.

playlists.title: Choro Mobile
playlists.description: Pair an iPhone, follow agent work away from the Mac, and respond with the right level of access.

videos.title: Meet Choro Remote
videos.flow: Mac runs Choro → iPhone follows → monitor and respond away from the desk
videos.viewer_value: Explains what Choro Remote is, what stays on the Mac, and when the phone is useful.

videos.title: Pair Your iPhone with Choro
videos.flow: Remote access → Connect & pair → enter Mac ID and code → connected
videos.viewer_value: Securely connects Choro Remote to the correct Mac with a one-time code.

videos.title: Choose What Your Phone Can Do
videos.flow: Paired devices → View only, Control, or Full access → confirm
videos.viewer_value: Keeps remote actions limited to the authority the user actually wants.

videos.title: Check Agent Progress from Your Phone
videos.flow: Projects → active agent → timeline and status → result
videos.viewer_value: Lets users understand progress and see when an agent needs attention.

videos.title: Start or Continue Agent Work on Mobile
videos.flow: Choose project → new or existing agent → configure → send
videos.viewer_value: Starts useful work or adds a follow-up without returning to the desktop.

videos.title: Respond to Questions, Plans, and Approvals
videos.flow: Needs attention → review request → answer or approve → continue
videos.viewer_value: Unblocks agents remotely while keeping higher-risk approvals protected.

videos.title: Review Results and Ask for Fixes on Mobile
videos.flow: Completed agent → changed files and verification → Ask to fix
videos.viewer_value: Turns a phone check into a precise correction instead of simple acceptance.

playlists.title: Productivity & Shortcuts
playlists.description: Small tools that make everyday work faster without changing the main workflow.

videos.title: Quick Ask, Project Talk, or Agent?
videos.flow: Choose intent → ask, discuss, or implement
videos.viewer_value: Helps users pick the lightest tool that fits the job.

videos.title: Ask Without Starting an Agent
videos.flow: Quick Ask → choose scope → ask → continue from history
videos.viewer_value: Answers small questions without creating another work conversation.

videos.title: Think Through a Project by Voice
videos.flow: Project Talk → discuss context → create plan if needed
videos.viewer_value: Supports hands-free thinking without giving edit authority.

videos.title: Dictate Prompts and Messages
videos.flow: Hold shortcut → speak → edit transcript → send
videos.viewer_value: Speeds up longer prompts while keeping the user in control.

videos.title: Find Anything in a Project
videos.flow: Search → filter results → jump to item
videos.viewer_value: Reduces time spent hunting through files, tasks, Docs, and agents.

videos.title: Customize Shortcuts and Notifications
videos.flow: Settings → shortcuts → notifications → preferred workflow
videos.viewer_value: Keeps Choro fast and appropriately quiet for each user.
